_purpose: Test which Grade C positioning angle resonates most on TikTok. Each prompt tests a different hook backed by org data. Results inform whether to scale Grade C as a product line push.
_blog_correlation: refurbished-iphone-buying-guide-2026 — Grade C section, Bundle deals section, Spring 2026 section, Sweet Spot Formula

angles.hypothesis: Flat lay showing full bundle contents triggers 'I need that' impulse. Accessory Compatibility Paralysis trend means showing everything included removes friction.
angles.data_backing: trends.json: Accessory Compatibility Paralysis | customer-language: '$800 phone for $350'
angles.post_copy_direction: List everything in the bundle with prices if bought separately. Show total savings.

angles.hook: Grade C doesn't mean what you think
angles.hypothesis: Before/after comparison — scratches visible without case, phone looks brand new with case. Directly addresses 'what's the catch?' objection. Behind-the-scenes content format has proven engagement.
angles.data_backing: customer-language: 'can't tell the difference' | engagement-log: behind-the-scenes builds trust
angles.post_copy_direction: Hook with 'the catch' then reveal it's just cosmetic. Case makes it invisible.

angles.hypothesis: Show the end result — Grade C phone in case on a premium desk setup. Looks indistinguishable from new. Dollar amount in hook triggers 40% higher engagement per engagement-log data.
angles.data_backing: engagement-log: 'dollar amounts outperform by 40%' | trends: Spring Supply Surge pricing
angles.post_copy_direction: Lead with price. Show lifestyle. 'Your friends won't know.'

angles.hypothesis: Dramatic cinematic lighting makes a budget phone look premium. Spring supply surge creates real urgency. Back Market crisis means competitors are weak right now.
angles.data_backing: trends: Spring Supply Surge 23% | daily-brief: Back Market multi-national crisis
angles.post_copy_direction: Urgency + premium feel. Limited spring inventory. Price anchor against retail.

iteration_plan.round_1: Generate 4 images, post to TikTok over 2 days (2 per day). Track engagement for 48 hours.
iteration_plan.round_2: Double down on top 2 performing angles. Generate 2 more variations of each winner.
iteration_plan.round_3: Scale winner to other platforms (Instagram, Twitter, Facebook) when connected.

success_metrics.engagement_rate: Track likes, comments, shares per post
success_metrics.winner_threshold: 2x engagement vs average TikTok post = scale signal
